purpose: Visual asset production targets, not D&D character sheet pregens

assets.silhouette: Armored shoulders and readable sword-shield silhouette; upright, planted stance
assets.equipment: Longsword, round shield, articulated plate, leather belt

animation.idle: Chest and shield settle; occasional blink
animation.move: Alternating heavy steps; shield counterbalances sword hand
animation.attack: Single guarded sword slash with deliberate recovery
animation.rest: Seated with shield on ground and sword lowered

assets.acceptance: Helmet, sword and shield identifiable at 64 px; equipment never floats

assets.silhouette: Narrow pointed ears, long robe and staff; avoids fighter proportions
assets.equipment: Gem staff, spellbook and layered sleeves

animation.idle: Robe hem sways; gem flickers slightly
animation.move: Short planted steps; sleeves and staff follow hands
animation.attack: Single arcane casting gesture with release, then reset
animation.rest: Staff laid down; seated with shoulders relaxed

assets.acceptance: Ears and robe profile visible at 64 px; magic not a permanent flash

assets.silhouette: Wide torso, short legs and visible beard; compact armored silhouette
assets.equipment: Mace, shield, chain/scale, original sunburst motif

animation.attack: One mace strike; optional distinct healing/casting variant later
animation.rest: Kneeling in quiet prayer; mace grounded

assets.acceptance: Dwarf not merely smaller human; no copied deity symbols

assets.silhouette: Small agile crouched figure; light hood, narrow gear silhouette
assets.equipment: Daggers, belt pouch, soft leather boots

animation.move: Quick stealth steps; feet touch ground cleanly
animation.attack: One swift knife jab then return to guard
animation.rest: Perched on low crate, blades lowered

assets.acceptance: Visibly rogue at 64 px; retain gnome ancestry rather than silently changing catalog

assets.silhouette: Broad shoulders, tusks and heavy two-hand weapon; fewer armor plates
assets.equipment: Greataxe, leather straps, fur wraps, simple bracers

animation.move: Powerful forward strides with axe inertia
animation.attack: Heavy two-handed overhead strike; believable follow-through
animation.rest: Sits heavily, axe set against ground

assets.acceptance: Axe grip actually two-handed; differs from Goblin silhouette

assets.silhouette: Ceremonial heavy armor, large shield and tabard; rigid protective posture
assets.equipment: Longsword, shield, cape, original radiance emblem

animation.move: Disciplined steps; shield and plate weight
animation.attack: Precise sword strike; optional radiance accent
animation.rest: Kneels, helmet lowered, blade point down

assets.acceptance: Distinguish from Fighter by tabard, silhouette and trim; no branded faction sigil

assets.silhouette: Lean elf, visible bow and quiver, compact leaf cloak
assets.equipment: Longbow, arrows, leather boots and belt knife

animation.move: Soft footfalls, cloak and quiver lag naturally
animation.rest: Bow unstrung by bedroll; knees bent

assets.acceptance: Bow string/quiver legible at 64 px; do not confuse with Rogue

assets.silhouette: Short expressive silhouette, recognizable instrument, lively coat
assets.equipment: Small lute, decorative rapier, travel coat and satchel

animation.attack: One short lute strum or rapier jab as variant

assets.acceptance: Instrument reads as lute, not weapon or shield; smaller than human

assets.silhouette: Original curved horns and tail; lean arcane silhouette
assets.equipment: Mystic focus, asymmetric mantle, robe/armor layers

animation.idle: Tail curls; restrained occult focus glow
animation.move: Measured steps; cape and tail counterbalance
animation.attack: Single force-energy casting gesture with discrete release
animation.rest: Reclines on low stool; focus dims

assets.acceptance: Distinct horns and tail at 64 px; avoid copyrighted named characters

assets.silhouette: Free-handed magical silhouette, less formal than staff-carrying Wizard
assets.equipment: Focus crystal, asymmetrical cloth mantle and bracers

animation.idle: Tiny hand glimmer and loose sleeves
animation.move: Brisk steps; cloth and floating focus respond
animation.attack: One controlled burst from open palm

assets.acceptance: Magic reads at small scale but does not hide facial identity

assets.silhouette: Unarmored balanced posture, visible wrapped fists and flexible trousers
assets.equipment: Hand wraps, rope belt, soft footwear

animation.attack: One full-body unarmed punch or kick, no floating body

assets.acceptance: No plate, shield or oversized weapon; foot placement credible

assets.silhouette: Organic layers, visible staff and natural-cloth shapes
assets.equipment: Wood staff, woven pack, leaf-shaped original ornament

animation.idle: Loose cloth and small twig movement
animation.move: Staff tracks floor contact; soft forest pace
animation.attack: Single vine/root burst or staff gesture
animation.rest: Kneels by bedroll, staff leaned aside

assets.acceptance: Nature traveler differs from robe Wizard; shapeshifts require separate beast rigs
